exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Expressing Uncertainty or Wonder".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～かなあ matches "Expressing Uncertainty or Wonder".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～かなあ.
exercises.explanation: Used to express uncertainty, doubt, or wonder, like "I wonder..."
